### Hi there 👋

I'm **Mandela Houngnibo**, an agro-hydro-meteorologist working as a junior expert at [AGRHYMET RCC-WAS](https://agrhymet.cilss.int/). Previously, I worked at [METEO BENIN](https://meteobenin.bj/) as the Head of the Studies and Meteorological Development Section.

## Bio

Throughout my academic journey, I earned a Bachelor's degree in Atmospheric Sciences and pursued a Master's degree in Agrometeorology. I'm currently a PhD candidate in agriculture and water sciences. Find my resume [here](https://github.com/hmandela/resume/blob/main/cv.pdf).

## Software

-   [**WASS2S**](https://github.com/hmandela/WASS2S) — a Python framework for seasonal-to-subseasonal (S2S) climate forecasting in West Africa: statistical, machine-learning and multi-model ensemble methods, with probabilistic tercile outputs. [Documentation](https://wass2s.readthedocs.io/).

## Selected papers

Houngnibo, M. C. M., Ali, A., Agali, A., Waongo, M., Lawin, A. E., & Cohard, J. M. (2023). **Stochastic disaggregation of seasonal precipitation forecasts of the West African Regional Climate Outlook Forum**. *International Journal of Climatology, 43*(12), 5569-5585.

Houngnibo, M. C. M., Minoungou, B., Traore, S. B., Maidment, R. I., Alhassane, A., & Ali, A. (2023). **Validation of high-resolution satellite precipitation products over West Africa for rainfall monitoring and early warning**. *Frontiers in Climate, 5*, 1185754.

You can find all [my publications here](https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=-wzU1PAAAAAJ&view_op=list_works&sortby=title).
